question: What is the exact damage formula in the packed native exe (protection vs shield order, min damage)?
probes: native_function_pseudocode on the packed cossacks.exe — but the exe is packed (section .bind entropy 7.96), static Ghidra analysis is likely useless; script evidence (data/scripts/lib/miscext2.script _misc_DoDamage) already gives the formula
resolution: The readable script miscext2.script _misc_DoDamage already gives the exact order: damage -= target shield (full if building finished, /3 otherwise), then protection[weapon kind], then clamp to 1; fast cavalry gets -5 for arrow/bullet. The native exe is packed, so the script evidence is the authoritative readable source.
